text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Strong indications emerged at the weekend that heads may roll at the central bank, following the unauthorised release of a copy of the bank's half-yearly economic report last week.
- A private sector housing scheme to complement government efforts has been launched in Lagos by ACEE HI-TECK construction company.
- The Apapa port in Lagos has generated 2.4 bilion naira between January and October 13 this year. This represents a big increase over the 1.5 billion revenue projection for the entire year.
- A proposal to increase food production through spending 8.0 billion naira on loans for peasants and small farmers is in the offing.
- Local governments may be dissolved in early November to prepare the ground for elections in December as the next step on the military government's plan to restore democracy.
